notes.title: Join the upcoming playtest!
notes.content:
For the latest news, updates, and playtesting opportunities, be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/qcXbTWER9F]join our Discord community[/url].

You can learn more about [url=https://settletopia.com/posts/settletopia-development-history/]the development history of Settletopia[/url].

If you love the concept, don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game on Steam to stay up to date.

Your support means the world to us! We can’t wait to share more with you soon!
